description: International Classification of Diseases, 10th Revision (WHO). Phase 1 demo seed; the SA-localised catalogue is held under ICD-10-ZA.
name: ICD-10

description: ICD-10 South African Master Industry Tariff edition. Loaded via `bench import-icd10`; canonical code system for SA medical-aid claims and HPCSA Booklet 9 record-keeping.
name: ICD-10-ZA

description: National Pharmaceutical Product Interface — SA medicine product code registry. Loaded via `bench import-nappi`. Required on prescriptions and dispensary stock items for medical-aid claim reconciliation.
name: NAPPI

description: Logical Observation Identifiers Names and Codes — universal lab analyte / clinical observation codes. Loaded via `bench import-loinc`. Used to FHIR-encode lab results from PathCare/Ampath/Lancet.
name: LOINC

description: Unified Code for Units of Measure. Loaded via `bench import-ucum`. Required by FHIR Quantity datatypes for vitals + lab observations.
name: UCUM

description: WHO Anatomical Therapeutic Chemical classification. Loaded via `bench import-atc`. Drives drug-class allergy matching (brand-swap traps) and HPCSA Booklet 8 prescribing checks.
name: ATC

description: SNOMED CT South African edition — STUB ONLY. Production catalogue import is gated on IHTSDO Affiliate licence procurement (deferred to Phase 5.6 / issue #38). Holds a placeholder seed for development.
name: SNOMED-CT-ZA-stub
